engineeringSkip.reason: Zero-point energy is a real quantum-vacuum concept, but harvesting it as an unlimited clean energy source (and as a route to computing and cryptography breakthroughs) is a free-energy claim with no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Zero-point energy is a real quantum concept, but the vacuum's ground state is by definition its lowest energy and cannot be tapped for unlimited free power — doing so would violate thermodynamics.
